fall_detected: Use the fall view to confirm low post-fall movement.
Escalate to the configured caregiver workflow if the resident does not respond.
temperature_high: Verify the reading with a contact thermometer.
Check hydration, ventilation, and recent exercise context.
Escalate if the elevated trend persists or appears with distress signals.
temperature_low: Verify the sensor contact and room conditions.
Check for prolonged inactivity or exposure.
Escalate if the reading remains low.
crowd_near_capacity: Keep the room below the 8-person limit.
Use another monitored room if occupancy keeps rising.
